admission.justification: Spans host agents and the AR server: one bound server per created agent plus narrow Claude-only server_info preapproval, with D124's assignment_read removal, bounds the multi-agent surface FAM-N17BB4 launches into.

applicability: Role launches under the runtime provider capability branch.
conditions: The task-server definition is supplied only when accepts_tool_servers is true.
Any preapproval is the Claude-only server_info identity read.
exclusions: The removed assignment_read grant and any alternative task reader.
Broad tool grants, which no launch carries.
An unconditional one-server or host-actual exclusion claim for a provider that declares supportsMcpServers=false.
statement: A created host agent whose provider accepts MCP definitions receives its own bound AR task-server definition; an explicitly unsupported provider receives no definition and no harness-configuration fallback. Claude-only preapproval remains narrow server_info identity access. D124 removes assignment_read and its former grant, not a replacement task reader.
